meta.name: fix
meta.description: Fix failing or flaky Playwright tests. Use when user says "fix test", "flaky test", "test failing", "debug test", "test broken", "test passes sometimes", or "intermittent failure".

copy.tagline: 修复 Playwright 测试的失败或间歇性问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到 Playwright 测试不稳定或失败的情况
copy.tagline_en: Fix failing or flaky Playwright tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often deal with unstable or failing Playwright tests

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 诊断并修复 Playwright 测试失败或间歇性通过的问题。它会重现错误、分类原因（如时序、隔离、环境、基础设施），然后应用针对性修复并验证。
howto.when: 当你说“fix test”、“flaky test”、“test failing”、“debug test”、“test broken”、“test passes sometimes”或“intermittent failure”时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复这个登录测试，它在 CI 中失败但本地通过。
say.note: 技能会分析环境差异并给出修复。

say.text: 这个测试有时通过有时失败，帮我诊断一下。
say.note: 技能会运行多次并分类失败原因。

howto.what_en: Diagnose and fix Playwright tests that fail or pass intermittently. It reproduces the error, categorizes the failure (timing/async, test isolation, environment, infrastructure), applies a targeted fix, and verifies stability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "fix test", "flaky test", "test failing", "debug test", "test broken", "test passes sometimes", or "intermittent failure".

say_en.text: Fix this login test that fails in CI but passes locally.
say_en.note: Skill will analyze environment differences and suggest a fix.

say_en.text: This test passes sometimes, diagnose it.
say_en.note: Skill will run multiple times and categorize the failure.
